comparisons.description: The fast user switching menu open under the user name, Aqua: the highlighted 64 pt cell, and the 235 pt menu attached under the bar at the cell's trailing edge, with two 34 pt user rows (the first highlighted), separators and two items.

comparisons.name: time-machine-menu-dark
comparisons.description: The Time Machine status menu in Dark Aqua, held to pixels of the Time-Machine-Menu screenshot: the open cell, the menu's edges and the highlighted row. The whole crop is not compared in Dark Aqua: over this dark part of the picture the shared menu material is about 16 levels lighter than the capture, which no budget of the tight tier holds.

pixels.note: the bar before the cell, which starts at x 5 (measured @ 4,20)
top of the highlighted row, Enter Time Machine, which starts at y 95: the dark menu highlight measured on the Contacts action menu (menu-item spec); this capture reads #0764d1
bottom of the same row, which ends at y 114
the picture left of the menu, which starts at x 5 (measured @ 5,160)
the picture right of the menu, which is 262 pt wide and ends at x 267 (measured @ 539,160)

comparisons.name: user-menu-dark
comparisons.description: The fast user switching menu in Dark Aqua, held to pixels of the Fast-User-Switching-Menu screenshot: the open cell, the menu's edges and the highlighted 34 pt user row. The whole crop is not compared in Dark Aqua: over this dark part of the picture the shared menu material is about 16 levels lighter than the capture, which no budget of the tight tier holds.

pixels.note: the bar after the cell, which ends at x 240 (measured @ 486,20)
top of the highlighted user row, which starts at y 26: the dark menu highlight measured on the Contacts action menu (menu-item spec); this capture reads #0863ce
bottom of the same row, 34 pt high, which ends at y 60
the picture left of the menu, which is 235 pt wide and starts at x 5 (measured @ 5,160)
the picture right of the menu, whose trailing edge is the cell's at x 240 (measured @ 485,160)
